3-0176-0000.sourceText:
Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, stiamo procedendo a un voto che rappresenta un allineamento tecnico per la partecipazione del Marocco a PRIMA, Partenariato per la ricerca e l'innovazione nell'area del Mediterraneo, con focus su acqua, agricoltura e sicurezza alimentare.

Questo voto ne garantirà la continuità fino al 2031, senza implicazioni di bilancio.

Io ne approfitto anche per ringraziare i colleghi della commissione ITRE, che hanno votato il provvedimento in commissione quasi all'unanimità.

Ciò premesso, però, vorrei ampliare la riflessione al tema dell'agricoltura, visto che non possiamo guardare a un accordo con il Marocco senza estendere la nostra visione a un quadro più ampio delle relazioni, in particolar modo sul fronte agricolo.

Solo negli ultimi due mesi del 2025 il Marocco ha coperto oltre il 70 % delle importazioni extra‑UE per quanto riguarda il pomodoro, un flusso che negli ultimi vent'anni è quadruplicato.

Per cui, questa relazione vorrebbe anche aprire una riflessione sul tema che la Commissione dovrebbe monitorare l'attuazione di queste tipologie di accordi, anche quelli riferiti alla ricerca e all'innovazione, con particolare attenzione alle importazioni agricole, affinché siano rispettati i principi di reciprocità e concorrenza leale.
3-0176-0000.englishText:
Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, we are proceeding with a vote that represents a technical alignment for Morocco's participation in PRIMA, Partnership for Research and Innovation in the Mediterranean Area, with a focus on water, agriculture and food security.

This vote will guarantee its continuity until 2031, without budgetary implications.

I also take this opportunity to thank my colleagues on the ITRE commission, who voted for the provision in the commission almost unanimously.

Having said this, however, I would like to broaden the reflection to the topic of agriculture, given that we cannot look at an agreement with Morocco without extending our vision to a broader picture of relations, particularly on the agricultural front.

In the last two months of 2025 alone, Morocco covered over 70 % of non-EU tomato imports, a flow that has quadrupled in the last twenty years.

Therefore, this report would also like to open a reflection on the issue that the Commission should monitor the implementation of these types of agreements, including those relating to research and innovation, with particular attention to agricultural imports, so that the principles of reciprocity and fair competition are respected.

3-0180-0000.sourceText: Panie Przewodniczący! Proponujemy poprawkę w następującym brzmieniu (przeczytam ją w tej chwili): „Parlament Europejski upomina się o pamięć 100 tys. bestialsko pomordowanych w rzezi wołyńskiej Polaków i Żydów; zdecydowanie nie akceptuje kultu bandytów z Ukraińskiej Powstańczej Armii i Stefana Bandery, którzy odpowiadają za ludobójstwo i współpracę z Hitlerem; wzywa władze Ukrainy do natychmiastowego zaprzestania ich państwowego upamiętniania oraz gloryfikacji; kultywowanie pamięci o ludobójcach jest sprzeczne z moralnością i wartościami europejskimi; dlatego wzywamy władze Ukrainy do jednoznacznego odrzucenia gloryfikacji osób odpowiedzialnych za ludobójstwo; podkreśla, że ideologia banderowska jest lustrzanym odbiciem ideologii nazistowskiej i – tak jak nazizm – banderyzm musi zostać uznany za ideologię zakazaną w Unii Europejskiej”.
3-0180-0000.englishText: Mr President! We propose an amendment in the following wording (I will read it now): "The European Parliament demands the memory of 100,000 Poles and Jews brutally murdered in the Volhynia massacre; it strongly does not accept the cult of bandits from the Ukrainian Insurgent Army and Stefan Bandera, who are responsible for genocide and cooperation with Hitler; calls on the Ukrainian authorities to immediately stop their state commemoration and glorification; "cultivating the memory of genociders is contrary to European morality and values; therefore, we call on the Ukrainian authorities to clearly reject the glorification of those responsible for genocide; emphasizes that the Bandera ideology is a mirror image of Nazi ideology and - like Nazism - Banderaism must be recognized as a banned ideology in the European Union."

3-0183-0000.sourceText:
Monsieur le Président, la perspective de l’adhésion de l’Ukraine à l’Union européenne constituerait une menace majeure pour l’agriculture de nos nations. Nos agriculteurs en subissent déjà les conséquences depuis 2022. La libéralisation des importations agricoles ukrainiennes, que seul le groupe des Patriotes a combattu dès le départ, a entraîné l’arrivée massive de sucre, de céréales et de volailles sur le marché européen, au détriment du revenu de nos producteurs.

Pourtant, la Commission veut aller plus loin. Dans sa nouvelle stratégie sur les protéines végétales présentée hier, elle confirme son renoncement à l’ambition de voir l’agriculture européenne satisfaire nos besoins en protéines végétales, pour aggraver les importations depuis l’Ukraine.

Je propose donc l’amendement suivant pour créer un nouveau paragraphe 32: «souligne que la Commission, dans sa dernière stratégie en matière de protéines, propose de s’appuyer sur la capacité de production agricole de l’Ukraine pour remédier à la pénurie de protéines végétales dans l’Union, au lieu de privilégier le développement de la production européenne».
3-0183-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, the prospect of Ukraine joining the European Union would pose a major threat to our nations' agriculture. Our farmers have already been suffering the consequences since 2022. The liberalization of Ukrainian agricultural imports, which only the Patriots group fought from the start, has led to the massive arrival of sugar, cereals and poultry on the European market, to the detriment of the income of our producers.

However, the Commission wants to go further. In its new strategy on plant proteins presented yesterday, it confirms its renunciation of the ambition to see European agriculture satisfy our needs for plant proteins, to worsen imports from Ukraine.

I therefore propose the following amendment to create a new paragraph 32: “underlines that the Commission, in its latest protein strategy, proposes to rely on Ukraine's agricultural production capacity to address the shortage of plant proteins in the Union, instead of prioritizing the development of European production”.

3-0191-0000.sourceText: Monsieur le Président, sur le même sujet, mais pas au moment du même vote, le collègue qui s’assoit au numéro 286, je crois, ou 288, a fait un bras d’honneur – a fait un bras d’honneur! – au moment du vote. Ce geste-là, en direction de cette partie de l’assemblée. Et c’est profondément insupportable! Vous avez le droit d’être les relais de Vladimir Poutine dans cette enceinte, mais ne vous comportez pas comme des fascistes russes!
3-0191-0000.englishText: Mr President, on the same subject, but not at the same time of the same vote, the colleague who sits at number 286, I believe, or 288, made an arm of honor – made an arm of honor! – at the time of voting. This gesture, towards this part of the assembly. And it’s deeply unbearable! You have the right to be Vladimir Putin's relays in this forum, but do not behave like Russian fascists!

3-0193-0000.sourceText: Herr Präsident! Vor allem vielen Dank an den Kollegen aus Deutschland, der sich dagegen ausspricht, dass hier Kollegen als Nazis beschimpft werden, denn Herr Brandstätter, Ihr Freund im Geiste, hat mich, einen tschechischen Flüchtling, gestern „das freundliche Gesicht des Nationalsozialismus” genannt. Das verbitte ich mir, und ich denke, das sollte geahndet werden.
3-0193-0000.englishText: Mr. President! Above all, many thanks to the colleague from Germany who speaks out against colleagues here being insulted as Nazis, because Mr. Brandstätter, your spiritual friend, called me, a Czech refugee, “the friendly face of National Socialism” yesterday. I condone that and I think it should be punished.

3-0200-0000.sourceText:
I will have this oral amendment, but first I have to tell you and I will do it in German – according to Rule 180, I must have the possibility to say that what he just said is not true.

Ich habe gestern gesagt: Es gibt den deutschen Bundestagsabgeordneten der AfD namens Matthias Helferich, und er hat sich einmal bezeichnet als „das freundliche Gesicht des Nationalsozialismus”. Matthias Helferich, Mitglied des Deutschen Bundestages, AfD. Genau das habe ich gestern gesagt.

Ich habe es nicht zu Herrn Bystron gesagt, und deswegen hat er jetzt die Unwahrheit gesagt. Ich würde Sie bitten, Herr Präsident, dass Sie Herrn Bystron die Möglichkeit geben, sich für seine Unwahrheit zu entschuldigen.
3-0200-0000.englishText:
I will have this oral amendment, but first I have to tell you and I will do it in German – according to Rule 180, I must have the possibility to say that what he just said is not true.

I said yesterday: There is a German AfD member of the Bundestag named Matthias Helferich, and he once described himself as “the friendly face of National Socialism”. Matthias Helferich, member of the German Bundestag, AfD. That's exactly what I said yesterday.

I didn't tell Mr. Bystron, and that's why he has now told the untruth. I would ask you, Mr. President, to give Mr. Bystron the opportunity to apologize for his untruth.

3-0221-0000.sourceText:
Κύριε Πρόεδρε, μπορεί η επίσημη κατάπαυση του πυρός στη Γάζα να συμφωνήθηκε τον περασμένο Οκτώβριο, όμως στην πραγματικότητα ο πόλεμος συνεχίζεται ακόμη και σήμερα. Τα χτυπήματα δεν σταμάτησαν ποτέ. Η ανθρωπιστική πρόσβαση συνεχίζει να γίνεται μετ' εμποδίων και η πλειοψηφία των κατοίκων της παραμένει εκτοπισμένη. Την ίδια στιγμή, η κατάσταση στη Δυτική Όχθη επιδεινώνεται. Το 2026 η βία των εποίκων έφτασε σε πρωτοφανή επίπεδα. Νέοι παράνομοι εποικισμοί, καταστροφές και κατασχέσεις σε περιουσίες χριστιανών και Αράβων, ακόμα και εντός του διαδρόμου Ε1.

Όλα αυτά τα μέτρα εδραιώνουν μια de facto προσάρτηση με μόνο στόχο να μπλοκάρουν κάθε βιώσιμη προοπτική για τη λύση των δύο κρατών. Για τον λόγο αυτό, ζητήσαμε ως ομάδα των Σοσιαλιστών και Δημοκρατών τη σημερινή επίκαιρη συζήτηση στην Ολομέλεια, αφού ήταν ο μόνος τρόπος να το θέσουμε ξανά, γιατί η Ευρώπη δεν μπορεί να παραμένει άλλο θεατής στις παραβιάσεις του διεθνούς και ανθρωπιστικού δικαίου. Δεν μπορούμε να θέλουμε να εμφανιζόμαστε ως οι υπερασπιστές της διεθνούς έννομης τάξης και την ίδια στιγμή το Συμβούλιο Υπουργών Εξωτερικών να μην μπορεί να αναγνωρίσει την πραγματικότητα, ότι δηλαδή παραβιάζεται το άρθρο 2 της Συμφωνίας Σύνδεσης, και να λάβει τις απαραίτητες στοχευμένες κυρώσεις κατά των εποίκων αλλά και κατά των ακροδεξιών υπουργών της κυβέρνησης Νετανιάχου. Δεν μπορούμε από τη μια να υπερασπιζόμαστε τα Ηνωμένα Έθνη και από την άλλη να συμμετέχει η Επιτροπή, έστω και ως παρατηρητής, στο Συμβούλιο Ειρήνης του προέδρου Τραμπ.

Σας το είπαμε, κυρία Επίτροπε: Ήταν λάθος σας που πήγατε, τόσο δικό σας όσο και της Προέδρου της Επιτροπής, που σας το ζήτησε. Δεν είχατε καμία εξουσιοδότηση για να συμμετάσχετε. Όπως επίσης ήταν πολύ λανθασμένη και η πρόσφατη επίσκεψή σας στο Ισραήλ. Δεν είχε τη σαφήνεια ούτε την απαραίτητη αυστηρότητα απέναντι στην κυβέρνηση Νετανιάχου και έγινε σε μια πολύ λάθος στιγμή, όταν η ισραηλινή κυβέρνηση επιτέθηκε στην Ύπατη Εκπρόσωπο. Μόνο και μόνο γι' αυτό, η επίσκεψη έπρεπε να έχει ακυρωθεί. Όταν ο θεσμικός μας εκπρόσωπος δέχεται επιθέσεις, η σιωπή δεν είναι ουδετερότητα, είναι υποχώρηση.

Κυρία Επίτροπε, το ζήτημα της ανασυγκρότησης της Γάζας και η διασφάλιση των προϋποθέσεων για ένα βιώσιμο παλαιστινιακό κράτος είναι πολύ σοβαρό ζήτημα, για να το αφήσουμε σε έναν ιδιωτικό μηχανισμό εκτός του διεθνούς πλαισίου. Ζητούμε έναν μηχανισμό ανασυγκρότησης της Γάζας με κεντρικό ρόλο των Ηνωμένων Εθνών, συμπεριλαμβανομένης της UNRWA, όπου τον κύριο λόγο θα τον έχουν οι Παλαιστίνιοι. Μόνο έτσι θα είναι επιτυχής. Η Ευρώπη πρέπει να είναι όχι μόνο παρούσα αλλά η κινητήριος δύναμη. Δεν αρκεί πια να είμαστε απλώς ο μεγαλύτερος χορηγός ανθρωπιστικής βοήθειας στην περιοχή. Θα πρέπει να έχουμε και την αντίστοιχη επιρροή και συμμετοχή. Δεν θα αποφασίζει κάποιος άλλος και εμείς απλώς θα πληρώνουμε.

Για τον λόγο αυτό, επαναλαμβάνω το αίτημά μας για μια φιλόδοξη, ολοκληρωμένη και συνεκτική στρατηγική για τη Μέση Ανατολή, που θα αντιστοιχεί στο μέγεθος της πρόκλησης, χωρίς διπλά μέτρα και σταθμά, με σαφή φωνή και με πολιτική βούληση. Μας το υποσχέθηκε η Πρόεδρος πριν από δύο χρόνια και ακόμα δεν έχει ξεκινήσει καν η προεργασία.
3-0221-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, the official ceasefire in Gaza may have been agreed last October, but in reality the war is still going on today. The hits never stopped. Humanitarian access continues to be hampered and the majority of its inhabitants remain displaced. At the same time, the situation in the West Bank is deteriorating. In 2026 settler violence reached unprecedented levels. New illegal settlements, destruction and confiscation of Christian and Arab properties, even within the E1 corridor.

All these measures consolidate a de facto annexation with the sole aim of blocking any viable prospect for a two-state solution. For this reason, we as a group of Socialists and Democrats asked for today's topical debate in the Plenary, since it was the only way to raise it again, because Europe can no longer remain a spectator to the violations of international and humanitarian law. We cannot want to appear as the defenders of the international legal order and at the same time the Council of Foreign Ministers cannot recognize the reality, namely that Article 2 of the Association Agreement is being violated, and take the necessary targeted sanctions against the settlers but also against the far-right ministers of the Netanyahu government. We cannot on the one hand defend the United Nations and on the other hand have the Commission participate, even as an observer, in President Trump's Peace Council.

We told you, Madam Commissioner: It was your fault that you went, both yours and the President of the Commission's, who asked you to. You had no authorization to join. Also your recent visit to Israel was very wrong. It did not have the clarity or the necessary rigor towards the Netanyahu government and it came at a very wrong time, when the Israeli government attacked the High Representative. For that alone, the visit should have been cancelled. When our institutional representative is under attack, silence is not neutrality, it is retreat.

Commissioner, the issue of rebuilding Gaza and ensuring the conditions for a viable Palestinian state is too serious to be left to a private mechanism outside the international framework. We call for a mechanism for the reconstruction of Gaza with a central role of the United Nations, including UNRWA, where the Palestinians will have the main say. Only then will he be successful. Europe must not only be present but the driving force. It is no longer enough to simply be the largest donor of humanitarian aid in the region. We should also have the corresponding influence and participation. No one else will decide and we will just pay.

For this reason, I repeat our call for an ambitious, comprehensive and coherent strategy for the Middle East, commensurate with the scale of the challenge, without double standards, with a clear voice and with political will. The President promised us this two years ago and still the preparatory work has not even started.

3-0225-0000.sourceText:
Señor presidente, Hamás, Hezbolá, etcétera. Lo mencionamos, pero vamos al tema de hoy, que es la responsabilidad de Israel.

Comisaria Šuica, usted me dijo en algunas ocasiones: ¿habrá dinero para la reconstrucción? Hay distintas partidas de las que sacar dinero. Yo creo que crear un mecanismo para Gaza da visibilidad externa a nuestro compromiso. Por tanto, le ruego que reexamine la posibilidad de, en vez de tomar dinero de varias partidas, crear este mecanismo que nuestro Grupo le está pidiendo.

Vamos a acabar con los dobles estándares. Estamos hablando todo el día de la responsabilidad de Rusia en la reconstrucción de Ucrania. ¿Por qué es tan difícil hablar de la responsabilidad de Israel en la reconstrucción de Gaza? ¿No es la misma violación del Derecho internacional a la que hemos asistido? Por tanto, hay que exigirle a Israel lo mismo que le exigimos a Rusia.

Comisaria, yo no la culpo a usted. A usted la han enviado a la Junta de Paz. La señora Von der Leyen la ha enviado a saludar a ministros genocidas. Yo entiendo que ustedes son un equipo. Por favor, comisaria, cuando tenga que saludar a esos ministros, muestre alguna incomodidad por estar en ese papel.
3-0225-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, Hamas, Hezbollah, etc. We mentioned it, but let's get to today's topic, which is Israel's responsibility.

Commissioner Šuica, you told me on some occasions: will there be money for reconstruction? There are different items from which to get money. I believe that creating a mechanism for Gaza gives external visibility to our commitment. Therefore, I ask you to re-examine the possibility of, instead of taking money from various sources, creating this mechanism that our Group is asking of you.

Let's put an end to double standards. We talk all day about Russia's responsibility in the reconstruction of Ukraine. Why is it so difficult to talk about Israel's responsibility in the reconstruction of Gaza? Isn't this the same violation of international law that we have witnessed? Therefore, we must demand from Israel the same as we demand from Russia.

Commissioner, I don't blame you. They have sent you to the Peace Board. Mrs Von der Leyen has sent her to greet genocidal ministers. I understand that you are a team. Please, commissioner, when you have to greet those ministers, show some discomfort at being in that role.

3-0226-0000.sourceText:
Herr Präsident, meine sehr geehrten Damen und Herren! Halten wir fest, dass Israel die einzige Demokratie im Nahen Osten ist. Halten wir ferner fest – auch wenn Sie lachen –, dass Israel umgeben ist von einer halben Milliarde Muslimen, wo sehr viel an Bedrohung gegeben ist. Halten wir ferner fest, dass an diesem 7. Oktober 2023 der brutalste Anschlag überhaupt stattgefunden hat auf Israel, mit über 1 200 Toten, wo Zivilisten missbraucht wurden als lebende Schilde. Ich weiß schon, dass Sie gern lachen, das ist aber Faktum. Halten wir ferner fest, dass wir wissen, dass die Europäische Union über UNRWA Mittel in den Gazastreifen gepumpt hat und dass diese Gelder aber in den Terrorküchen der Hamas gelandet sind. Das ist der falsche Weg.

Leute wie der israelische Außenminister Gideon Sa'ar und auch die Amerikaner haben recht: Diese Terrororganisationen sind endlich zu entwaffnen. Es hat eine Demilitarisierung dieser Region stattzufinden, und erst dann, und nachdem sichergestellt wird, dass Israel sein Recht auf Existenz und Verteidigung behält, kann man über entsprechende Hilfen reden.
3-0226-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, ladies and gentlemen! Let us note that Israel is the only democracy in the Middle East. Let us also note - even if you laugh - that Israel is surrounded by half a billion Muslims, where there is a great deal of threat. Let us also note that this October 7, 2023, the most brutal attack ever took place on Israel, with over 1,200 deaths, where civilians were used as living shields. I know you like to laugh, but that's a fact. Let us also note that we know that the European Union pumped funds into the Gaza Strip through UNRWA and that these funds ended up in Hamas' terrorist kitchens. That's the wrong way.

People like Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar and the Americans are right: these terrorist organizations must finally be disarmed. This region must be demilitarized and only then, and after it has been ensured that Israel retains its right to exist and defend itself, can we talk about appropriate aid.

3-0227-0000.sourceText:
Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, oggi la comunità internazionale è chiamata ad affrontare due sfide inseparabili.

La prima è garantire un'assistenza umanitaria immediata alla popolazione civile, la seconda è fare in modo che il 7 ottobre resti confinato alla storia e non torni mai più a segnare il futuro del Medio Oriente.

La prima impone di assicurare un accesso umanitario pieno, sicuro e senza ostacoli, affinché gli aiuti raggiungano rapidamente chi ne ha bisogno, senza essere intercettati o strumentalizzati da organizzazioni terroristiche.

La seconda richiede una visione politica di lungo periodo. La ricostruzione di Gaza dovrà accompagnarsi allo smantellamento delle reti terroristiche e ogni forma di estremismo che ha alimentato l'odio e la violenza.

L'Europa deve guidare questo processo mobilitando gli strumenti già disponibili per ricostruire ospedali, scuole e infrastrutture essenziali e creare le condizioni per una crescita economica e duratura, perché dalla stabilità di Gaza passa anche la stabilità del Mediterraneo, e dalla stabilità del Mediterraneo passa una parte decisiva della sicurezza e della prosperità dell'Europa.
3-0227-0000.englishText:
Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, today the international community is called to face two inseparable challenges.

The first is to guarantee immediate humanitarian assistance to the civilian population, the second is to ensure that 7 October remains confined to history and never again marks the future of the Middle East.

The first requires ensuring full, safe and unhindered humanitarian access, so that aid quickly reaches those who need it, without being intercepted or exploited by terrorist organizations.

The second requires a long-term political vision. The reconstruction of Gaza will have to be accompanied by the dismantling of terrorist networks and every form of extremism that has fueled hatred and violence.

Europe must lead this process by mobilizing the tools already available to rebuild hospitals, schools and essential infrastructures and create the conditions for lasting economic growth, because the stability of the Mediterranean also depends on the stability of Gaza, and a decisive part of the security and prosperity of Europe depends on the stability of the Mediterranean.

3-0229-0000.sourceText:
Hr. formand! Temaet for debatten i dag er genopbygning af Gaza, og jeg siger det til oplysning for højrefløjen, som gerne vil diskutere alt muligt andet. Men endnu vigtigere: respekten for menneskeliv og menneskeværd skal genoprettes.

Mere end 70 000 mennesker bekræftes døde. Intet her i verden – heller ikke Hamas' forfærdelige terrorangreb – berettiger drab på mange uskyldige mennesker og fastholdelse af mere end 2 millioner mennesker i en katastrofal situation.

Mange tusinder ligger gemt – men ikke glemt – under ruinerne. De oplever nu at leve i kaos, affald, forurenet vand og skadedyr. EU og EU's medlemslande ved godt, hvad der sker. Vi ved godt, hvad der sker, ikke alene her, men også på Vestbredden. Selv uden adgang til internationale journalister ved vi, hvad der sker.

Vi taler om frihed, om fred. Vi taler om respekt og retfærdighed. Men vi handler stadig med ulovlige bosættelser. Vi har stadig en associeringsaftale, der endda har menneskerettigheder skrevet ind som forudsætning.

Vores handlingslammelse er en moralsk skamplet.
3-0229-0000.englishText:
Mr. chairman! The topic of the debate today is the reconstruction of Gaza, and I say that for the information of the right wing, who want to discuss everything else. But even more important: respect for human life and human dignity must be restored.

More than 70,000 people are confirmed dead. Nothing in this world – not even the horrific terrorist attacks of Hamas – justifies the killing of many innocent people and the detention of more than 2 million people in a catastrophic situation.

Many thousands are hidden – but not forgotten – under the ruins. They now experience living in chaos, waste, polluted water and pests. The EU and its member states know very well what is happening. We know what is happening, not only here, but also on the West Bank. Even without access to international journalists, we know what is happening.

We are talking about freedom, about peace. We are talking about respect and justice. But we still deal with illegal settlements. We still have an association agreement that even has human rights written in as a prerequisite.

Our paralysis of action is a moral blemish.

3-0233-0000.sourceText:
Señor presidente, señorías, el título de este debate, para empezar, es tramposo: juzga la responsabilidad de Israel y omite la del culpable. Todo debate serio exige partir de la verdad y aquí algunos grupos se han instalado en la mentira deliberada.

Tres hechos se obvian una y otra vez. Primero, si hablamos de reconstruir Gaza es porque Hamás decidió destruirla. El 7 de octubre de 2023, una organización terrorista asesinó a más de 1 200 personas, el mayor asesinato de judíos desde el Holocausto. Y quien omite esta responsabilidad no busca la paz, sino una coartada.

Segundo, la Comisión Europea y algunos Estados miembros —con el Gobierno corrupto socialista español a la cabeza— siguen financiando al UNRWA, cuyos empleados estuvieron implicados en la masacre.

Tercero, el artículo 51 de la Carta de las Naciones Unidas reconoce a todo Estado el derecho inmanente a la legítima defensa. A todo Estado, también a Israel.

Por eso, exigimos la suspensión inmediata de toda financiación al UNRWA y que no se desembolse ni un solo euro...

(el presidente retira la palabra al orador)
3-0233-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, ladies and gentlemen, the title of this debate, to begin with, is misleading: it judges Israel's responsibility and omits that of the guilty party. Every serious debate requires starting from the truth and here some groups have settled into deliberate lies.

Three facts are ignored again and again. First, if we talk about rebuilding Gaza it is because Hamas decided to destroy it. On October 7, 2023, a terrorist organization murdered more than 1,200 people, the largest murder of Jews since the Holocaust. And whoever omits this responsibility does not seek peace, but rather an alibi.

Second, the European Commission and some Member States – led by the corrupt socialist Spanish government – ​​continue to finance UNRWA, whose employees were involved in the massacre.

Third, Article 51 of the United Nations Charter recognizes every State's inherent right to self-defense. To every State, also to Israel.

For this reason, we demand the immediate suspension of all funding to UNRWA and that not a single euro be disbursed...

(the president removes the speaker from speaking)

3-0234-0000.sourceText: Voorzitter, als het ergens moeilijk is om perspectief te zien, dan is het wel in Gaza. Twee miljoen Palestijnen leven onder erbarmelijke omstandigheden, in een volstrekt uitzichtloze situatie. Allemaal de schuld van Israël, zeggen velen, maar dat is natuurlijk niet zo. Zeker, Israël moet zich maximaal inspannen om de humanitaire hulp bij de getroffen bevolking te krijgen. Maar we kunnen Israël toch onmogelijk verwijten dat ze probeert Hamas onder controle te krijgen? Dat brengt ons bij de kern van het probleem: de weigering van Hamas om de wapens neer te leggen. Hoe kan de EU dan helpen bij de wederopbouw? Ik zou willen zeggen: laten we ons daarbij concentreren op Hamasvrije gebieden. Zorg er in ieder geval voor dat er geen euro in handen komt van Hamas, want zolang deze terroristische organisatie er nog de lakens uitdeelt, blijft de situatie zoals die nu is volstrekt uitzichtloos.
3-0234-0000.englishText: Mr President, if it is difficult to see perspective anywhere, it is in Gaza. Two million Palestinians live in appalling conditions, in a completely hopeless situation. It's all Israel's fault, many say, but of course that is not the case. Certainly, Israel must make every effort to get humanitarian aid to the affected population. But surely we can't blame Israel for trying to control Hamas? That brings us to the heart of the problem: Hamas's refusal to lay down its arms. How can the EU help with reconstruction? I would like to say: let us concentrate on Hamas-free areas. In any case, make sure that no euro ends up in the hands of Hamas, because as long as this terrorist organization continues to rule the roost, the situation as it is now remains completely hopeless.

3-0237-0000.sourceText:
Señor presidente, señora comisaria, una pregunta: ¿Donald Trump tiene el teléfono de ustedes? ¿Les llama como llama al presidente de la FIFA? No sé, cuéntenos cómo son esas conversaciones. ¿Donald Trump les llama para que apoyen el genocidio, para que apoyen la ocupación ilegal de Cisjordania? ¿Les llama cuando van a quemar niños vivos o simplemente les llama para que estén calladitos y paguen sus guerras mientras bombardea a medio mundo?

Porque eso es lo que ve la gente, comisaria, que hay un grupo pequeño de hombres muy peligrosos que están destruyendo el mundo por negocios y a los que nadie les pone límite. Y hay un problema porque, ahora mismo, cogerle el teléfono a Trump es convertirle en el dueño de Europa y a ustedes en cómplices de sus crímenes.

Hagan algo ya: paren el genocidio, rompan relaciones con el Estado terrorista de Israel. Es su obligación. Dejen de cogerle el teléfono a Donald Trump. ¡Cuélguenle el teléfono!
3-0237-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, Madam Commissioner, a question: Does Donald Trump have your phone number? Do you call them what you call the president of FIFA? I don't know, tell us what those conversations are like. Does Donald Trump call on you to support genocide, to support the illegal occupation of the West Bank? Does he call them when they are going to burn children alive or does he simply call them to be quiet and pay for his wars while he bombs half the world?

Because that's what people see, Commissioner, that there is a small group of very dangerous men who are destroying the world for business and to whom no one sets limits. And there is a problem because, right now, picking up Trump's phone is turning him into the owner of Europe and you into accomplices in his crimes.

Do something now: stop the genocide, break relations with the terrorist State of Israel. It is your obligation. Stop picking up Donald Trump's phone. Hang up the phone!

3-0242-0000.sourceText:
Monsieur le Président, dans la reconstruction de Gaza culminent tous les problèmes que nous pouvons nous imaginer: le nombre de victimes, qui se comptent par dizaines de milliers, l’atténuation de la catastrophe humanitaire qui sévit toujours. La question de la responsabilité de la présente situation n’est pas seulement celle du gouvernement de Netanyahou, mais aussi celle du Hamas et de sa tutelle iranienne, sans vouloir passer sous silence ceux qui ne veulent en aucun cas accepter la solution à deux États,

L’Union européenne, quant à elle, reste divisée sur l’opportunité de mettre en œuvre le peu de moyens dont elle dispose pour peser sur le cours des choses – c’est du déjà-vu. Nous souffrons d’un manque d’autorité, et on est respectés ni par les uns ni par les autres. Tant que nous nous payons le luxe de la division, nous resterons un observateur impuissant de la situation au Moyen-Orient. Et la seule chose qu’on nous demandera, c’est de payer: «Player or payer. That’s the question.»

'Player or payer?' That's the question.
3-0242-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, in the reconstruction of Gaza all the problems that we can imagine culminate: the number of victims, who number in the tens of thousands, the mitigation of the humanitarian catastrophe which still rages. The question of responsibility for the present situation is not only that of Netanyahu's government, but also that of Hamas and its Iranian supervision, without wanting to ignore those who in no way want to accept the two-state solution,

The European Union, for its part, remains divided on the advisability of implementing the few means at its disposal to influence the course of things – it’s déjà vu. We suffer from a lack of authority, and we are respected by neither. As long as we indulge in the luxury of division, we will remain a helpless observer of the situation in the Middle East. And the only thing we will be asked is to pay: “Play or pay. That’s the question.”

'Play or pay?' That's the question.

3-0245-0000.sourceText:
Signor Presidente, signora Commissaria, onorevoli colleghi, dopo oltre 1 000 giorni di pulizia etnica, 75 000 morti accertati, milioni di sfollati, questo Parlamento ancora non condanna il genocidio israeliano.

E, per pulirvi la coscienza, ci proponete un dibattito sul ruolo dell'Unione europea nella ricostruzione di Gaza. Però, io dico, ma con quale coraggio, onestamente?

Ci sono migliaia di esseri umani che restano intrappolati in un campo di morte a cielo aperto, uccisi dalla fame, dalle malattie oppure dalle bombe democratiche di Tel Aviv.

L'Unione europea, in realtà, oggi è lo zerbino di Trump e di Netanyahu: da Tajani con il cappellino MAGA, a Meloni e von der Leyen, al "Board of Peace", fate a gara a inginocchiarvi dinanzi agli Stati Uniti, incapaci perfino di difendere i giudici della Corte penale internazionale o la relatrice Francesca Albanese.

Per salvare la dignità dell'Unione c'è una sola via: sospendere l'accordo di associazione con Israele e sanzionare il governo Netanyahu. Il resto è solo vergognosa ipocrisia.
3-0245-0000.englishText:
Mr President, Commissioner, ladies and gentlemen, after more than 1 000 days of ethnic cleansing, 75 000 confirmed deaths, millions of displaced people, this Parliament still does not condemn the Israeli genocide.

And, to clear your conscience, you propose a debate on the role of the European Union in the reconstruction of Gaza. But, I say, with what courage, honestly?

There are thousands of human beings who remain trapped in an open-air death camp, killed by hunger, disease or the democratic bombs of Tel Aviv.

The European Union, in reality, today is the doormat of Trump and Netanyahu: from Tajani with the MAGA hat, to Meloni and von der Leyen, to the "Board of Peace", you compete to kneel before the United States, incapable even of defending the judges of the International Criminal Court or the rapporteur Francesca Albanese.

To save the dignity of the Union there is only one way: suspend the association agreement with Israel and sanction the Netanyahu government. The rest is just shameful hypocrisy.

3-0246-0000.sourceText:
Κύριε Πρόεδρε, γενοκτονία με πάνω από 73.000 νεκρούς Παλαιστινίους, ισοπέδωση Γάζας, σχέδιο διαμελισμού και γενικευμένος εποικισμός στη Δυτική Όχθη με ιστορικό υψηλό δολοφονίας παιδιών: ατιμώρητα κατά συρροή εγκλήματα του κράτους κατακτητή Ισραήλ, με επίθεση επιπλέον στο Ιράν και εισβολή στον Λίβανο και τη Συρία.

Παράλληλα, επιβραβεύετε με προκλητική ασυλία επισκέψεις σαν της Επιτροπής στο Ισραήλ, στρατιωτικές και εμπορικές συμφωνίες από τις συνένοχες Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες, Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση, ΝΑΤΟ και την ελληνική κυβέρνηση. Το αμερικανικό σχέδιο δήθεν ειρήνης, όπως και το αντίστοιχο ΝΑΤΟϊκό σχέδιο «Πύλη της Ανατολικής Μεσογείου», που μεθοδεύτηκε στη σύναξη στην Άγκυρα, προωθούν τους ενεργειακούς εμπορικούς διαύλους ευρωατλαντικών συμφερόντων στον ανταγωνισμό με Κίνα και Ρωσία.

Παρ' όλα αυτά, οι εξελίξεις απέδειξαν ότι ο ιμπεριαλισμός δεν είναι άτρωτος. Δεν είστε παντοδύναμοι, γιατί ούτε τον παλαιστινιακό λαό ούτε αυτόν του Ιράν βάλατε στο χέρι. Με τη διεθνιστική αλληλεγγύη και την αυτοτελή του πάλη, ο παλαιστινιακός λαός έχει τη δύναμη να επιβάλει το δίκιο του για ανεξάρτητο παλαιστινιακό κράτος με πρωτεύουσα την Ανατολική Ιερουσαλήμ στα σύνορα του '67.
3-0246-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, genocide with over 73,000 dead Palestinians, razing of Gaza, planned dismemberment and widespread settlement in the West Bank with a high record of killing children: unpunished serial crimes of the occupying state of Israel, with additional attack on Iran and invasion of Lebanon and Syria.

At the same time, you reward with defiant immunity visits like the Commission's to Israel, military and trade deals by the complicit United States, the European Union, NATO and the Greek government. The American so-called peace plan, as well as the corresponding NATO "Gateway to the Eastern Mediterranean" plan, which was formulated at the meeting in Ankara, promote the energy trade channels of Euro-Atlantic interests in competition with China and Russia.

Nevertheless, developments proved that imperialism is not invulnerable. You are not omnipotent, because neither the Palestinian people nor the people of Iran have been put in your hands. With international solidarity and their independent struggle, the Palestinian people have the power to assert their right to an independent Palestinian state with East Jerusalem as its capital on the 1967 borders.

3-0250-0000.sourceText:
Monsieur le Président, chers collègues, Madame la Commissaire, le ministre des affaires étrangères israélien insulte Kaja Kallas, la cheffe de la diplomatie européenne, et quatre jours plus tard vous courez à Tel-Aviv lui serrer la main, sans doute avec l’approbation d’Ursula von der Leyen. Le signal envoyé est désastreux, et votre mépris pour la crédibilité européenne est total. Pour que le ridicule soit absolu, vous ajoutez qu’Israël est un partenaire clé.

Madame Šuica, Israël bloque l’aide humanitaire et les médicaments que vous envoyez à Gaza, Israël rase les infrastructures financées par l’Union européenne en ignorant vos demandes de remboursement, Israël poursuit une politique d’apartheid assumée, des crimes de guerre au Liban et un génocide à Gaza, malgré vos appels à la paix.

Madame Šuica, j’ai besoin de comprendre: quand nos traités ont-ils été modifiés pour vous autoriser à vous affranchir et à affranchir la politique étrangère européenne du droit international et des valeurs de l’Union européenne? Quels sont désormais les critères, quels sont vos critères pour qualifier un partenaire clé ou…

(Le Président retire la parole à l’orateur)
3-0250-0000.englishText:
Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, Commissioner, the Israeli Foreign Minister insults Kaja Kallas, the head of European diplomacy, and four days later you run to Tel Aviv to shake her hand, no doubt with the approval of Ursula von der Leyen. The signal sent is disastrous, and your contempt for European credibility is total. To make the ridiculousness absolute, you add that Israel is a key partner.

Ms. Suica, Israel is blocking the humanitarian aid and medicines that you send to Gaza, Israel is razing infrastructure financed by the European Union while ignoring your requests for reimbursement, Israel is pursuing a policy of apartheid, war crimes in Lebanon and genocide in Gaza, despite your calls for peace.

Ms Suica, I need to understand: when were our treaties amended to authorize you to free yourself and European foreign policy from international law and the values ​​of the European Union? What are the criteria now, what are your criteria to qualify a key partner or…

(The President cuts off the speaker)

3-0251-0000.sourceText:
Señor presidente, señorías, reconstruir Gaza no es solamente dedicar recursos para volver a hacerla habitable —que también—, sino cómo hacemos para que los palestinos y las palestinas sean los únicos dueños y gobernantes de ese territorio. Cómo hacemos, cómo actúa y presiona Europa para que Gaza no se convierta en un resort de lujo para millonarios sin empatía ni vergüenza.

Gaza no es tierra de nadie, es parte de la nación palestina y, por lo tanto, solo corresponde a palestinos y palestinas decidir, comenzando por los términos de la reconstrucción y acabando con el ejercicio del derecho a decidir, con el derecho de autodeterminación del pueblo de Palestina.

Cualquier otro que se arrogue esa competencia en sustitución del pueblo palestino siempre contará con nuestro rechazo y nuestra denuncia. Y esa debiera ser también la actitud de la Unión en defensa de la legalidad internacional.

A fecha de hoy, Palestina sigue siendo objeto de un genocidio planificado que ha costado más de 70 000 vidas. Situarse del lado correcto de la historia exige suspender inmediatamente el Acuerdo de Asociación UE-Israel y dar cobertura política a la Corte Penal Internacional, particularmente en lo referente a las órdenes de detención contra los perpetradores del genocidio palestino.
3-0251-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, ladies and gentlemen, rebuilding Gaza is not only about dedicating resources to make it habitable again - that too - but about how we ensure that the Palestinians are the sole owners and rulers of that territory. How do we do it, how does it act and put pressure on Europe so that Gaza does not become a luxury resort for millionaires without empathy or shame?

Gaza is no man's land, it is part of the Palestinian nation and, therefore, it is only up to Palestinians to decide, starting with the terms of reconstruction and ending with the exercise of the right to decide, with the right of self-determination of the people of Palestine.

Anyone else who assumes this competence to replace the Palestinian people will always have our rejection and our denunciation. And that should also be the attitude of the Union in defense of international legality.

To this day, Palestine remains the target of a planned genocide that has cost more than 70,000 lives. Getting on the right side of history requires immediately suspending the EU-Israel Association Agreement and giving political cover to the International Criminal Court, particularly regarding arrest warrants against the perpetrators of the Palestinian genocide.

3-0252-0000.sourceText:
Herr Präsident, Frau Kommissarin! Irgendwie haben alle Vorredner so ein bisschen recht, aber das wird den Menschen in Gaza tatsächlich nicht helfen. Der Aufbau – und da sind wir uns, glaube ich, alle klar – wird nur im Rahmen einer für alle Beteiligten politischen, grundsätzlichen Befriedung des Konfliktes möglich sein. Der EU fällt dabei die Rolle des zentralen finanziellen und diplomatischen Unterstützers zu, während Israel nach dem Völkerrecht als Besatzungsmacht primär für die Versorgung und den Wiederaufbau ziviler Infrastruktur verantwortlich wäre. In der Realität passiert genau das Gegenteil – und Frieden liegt in der Ferne.

Unterdessen muss die EU weiterhin in Zusammenarbeit mit allen Akteuren versuchen, humanitäre Hilfe nach Gaza zu bringen, und versuchen, die Verletzten des Gazakrieges zu retten. Wir sollten überlegen, ob wir die Mittel für die Grenzmission Rafah schnell in die Krankenhäuser von West Bank und Jordanien umleiten, um praktische Hilfe leisten zu können.

Letzte Woche war ich Zeuge der Evakuierung von Verletzten und Angehörigen über Jordanien nach Spanien und die Türkei. Danke Spanien, danke Jordanien, danke der Türkei!

Seien wir die EU, die für die Schwachen, die Entrechteten, die Betrogenen und die leidenden Verletzten die Völkerfamilie ist, die sich kümmert!
3-0252-0000.englishText:
Mr President, Commissioner! Somehow all the previous speakers are somewhat right, but that actually won't help the people in Gaza. The construction - and I think we are all clear on this - will only be possible within the framework of a political, fundamental pacification of the conflict for all those involved. The EU plays the role of central financial and diplomatic support, while under international law Israel, as an occupying power, would be primarily responsible for supplying and rebuilding civilian infrastructure. In reality, the exact opposite happens — and peace is far away.

Meanwhile, the EU must continue to work with all actors to bring humanitarian aid to Gaza and seek to rescue those injured in the Gaza war. We should consider quickly redirecting Rafah border mission funding to West Bank and Jordan hospitals to provide practical assistance.

Last week I witnessed the evacuation of injured people and relatives via Jordan to Spain and Turkey. Thank you Spain, thank you Jordan, thank you Turkey!

Let us be the EU that is the family of nations that cares for the weak, the disenfranchised, the betrayed and the suffering injured!

3-0253-0000.sourceText:
Herr talman! EU är den största givaren till den palestinska myndigheten, och inför nästa veckas möte i den palestinska givargruppen måste det vara glasklart att ekonomiskt stöd förutsätter konkreta reformer. Utan resultat finns inga förutsättningar för en varaktig fred.

Först måste Hamas avväpnas och genomgripande avradikalisering genomföras i Gaza. Skolundervisningen måste reformeras så att antisemitism, glorifiering av terrorism och martyrskap inte traderas till nästa generation.

I fjol betalade PA ut motsvarande 156 miljoner US-dollar i ersättningar och förmåner till terrorister och deras familjer inom ramen för pay to slay. Också detta måste omedelbart upphöra.

Om dessa förhållanden inte förändras förblir tvåstatslösningen en illusion. Kommissionen måste vara glasklar: Uteblivna reformer kommer att få kännbara ekonomiska konsekvenser. Europeiska skattebetalares pengar ska aldrig användas för att finansiera eller belöna terrorism.
3-0253-0000.englishText:
Mr Speaker! The EU is the largest donor to the Palestinian Authority, and ahead of next week's meeting of the Palestinian donor group, it must be crystal clear that financial support presupposes concrete reforms. Without results, there are no conditions for lasting peace.

First, Hamas must be disarmed and comprehensive deradicalization implemented in Gaza. School education must be reformed so that anti-Semitism, glorification of terrorism and martyrdom are not passed on to the next generation.

Last year, the PA paid out the equivalent of US$156 million in compensation and benefits to terrorists and their families under pay to slay. This too must stop immediately.

If these conditions do not change, the two-state solution will remain an illusion. The Commission must be crystal clear: Failure to reform will have tangible financial consequences. European taxpayers' money must never be used to finance or reward terrorism.

3-0254-0000.sourceText:
Monsieur le Président, Madame la Commissaire, chers collègues, à Gaza, le cessez-le-feu n’existe que sur le papier. Les frappes continuent. Elles tuent 125 Palestiniens chaque mois. L’armée israélienne ne s’est pas retirée; elle contrôle 60 % de la bande de Gaza.

Alors, dans ce Parlement, il faut que notre groupe insiste à chaque plénière pour que nous puissions juste débattre de ce qu’il se passe en Palestine. Toute discussion est systématiquement verrouillée par les groupes de droite et d’extrême droite. Pourquoi? Comment être à ce point aveugle à la souffrance humaine et à l’injustice?

Cela a été dit: il a fallu quelques heures au gouvernement israélien pour rompre les relations avec la haute représentante de l’Union européenne, Kaja Kallas, parce qu’elle dénonçait le régime d’apartheid en Cisjordanie. Mais nous, nous tergiversons depuis des années, sans suspension de l’accord d’association avec Israël. Nous n’avons toujours pas condamné la loi sur le rétablissement de la peine de mort en Israël, conçue pour ne s’appliquer qu’aux Palestiniens, toujours pas protégé la Cour pénale internationale contre les sanctions américaines.

Cette inaction complice est celle des droites européennes, que l’histoire jugera. Il y a des élections dans quelques mois en Palestine et en Israël. Une nouvelle génération peut arriver au pouvoir pour enfin travailler à la justice, à l’égalité des droits et à la paix. Il faut agir maintenant.
3-0254-0000.englishText:
Mr President, Madam Commissioner, dear colleagues, in Gaza, the ceasefire only exists on paper. The strikes continue. They kill 125 Palestinians every month. The Israeli army did not withdraw; it controls 60% of the Gaza Strip.

So, in this Parliament, our group must insist at each plenary so that we can just debate what is happening in Palestine. Any discussion is systematically blocked by right-wing and far-right groups. For what? How can we be so blind to human suffering and injustice?

It has been said that it took the Israeli government a few hours to break relations with the High Representative of the European Union, Kaja Kallas, because she denounced the apartheid regime in the West Bank. But we have been procrastinating for years, without suspending the association agreement with Israel. We have still not condemned the law reinstating the death penalty in Israel, designed to apply only to Palestinians, still not protected the International Criminal Court from US sanctions.

This complicit inaction is that of the European right, which history will judge. There are elections in a few months in Palestine and Israel. A new generation can come to power to finally work for justice, equal rights and peace. We must act now.

3-0256-0000.sourceText:
Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, volete sapere come possiamo opporci e garantire la ricostruzione di Gaza, la pace?

Dobbiamo opporci all'occupazione. Dobbiamo opporci al genocidio. Bisogna attribuire la responsabilità, prima di parlare di ricostruzione.

Le Nazioni Unite ce l'hanno detto: Israele ha deliberatamente ucciso bambini, Israele sta compiendo un genocidio.

E dove sono, ora, questi criminali? Sono a Gaza. Decidono cosa entra e cosa esce, chi entra e chi esce. Sono in Cisgiordania, dove fanno accordi con i coloni per rubare le terre dei palestinesi, catturarli e ucciderli brutalmente.

Israele sta illegalmente occupando Gaza e la Cisgiordania. Nel frattempo, i palestinesi a Gaza continuano a morire tra i topi, senza acqua, tra le rovine, sotto le bombe, tra i corpi dei loro cari.

E noi che facciamo? Continuiamo a fare affari con dei criminali di guerra, con un governo genocida, continuiamo a trattarli come alleati.

Basta! Dobbiamo interrompere i rapporti con Israele.

Ma di che ricostruzione state parlando? Di quella di Trump che vuole farci un resort o di Netanyahu che vuole annetterla a Israele? O del progettino coloniale del Board of Peace a cui l'Europa ha vergognosamente partecipato?

(Il Presidente toglie la parola all'oratrice)
3-0256-0000.englishText:
Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, do you want to know how we can oppose it and guarantee the reconstruction of Gaza, peace?

We must oppose the occupation. We must oppose genocide. Responsibility must be attributed before talking about reconstruction.

The United Nations told us: Israel deliberately killed children, Israel is committing genocide.

And where are these criminals now? I'm in Gaza. They decide what comes in and what goes out, who comes in and who goes out. They are in the West Bank, where they make deals with settlers to steal Palestinian lands, capture them and brutally kill them.

Israel is illegally occupying Gaza and the West Bank. Meanwhile, Palestinians in Gaza continue to die among the rats, without water, among the ruins, under the bombs, among the bodies of their loved ones.

And what do we do? We continue to do business with war criminals, with a genocidal government, we continue to treat them as allies.

Enough! We must sever relations with Israel.

But what reconstruction are you talking about? The one of Trump who wants to make a resort there or of Netanyahu who wants to annex it to Israel? Or the Board of Peace's colonial project in which Europe shamefully participated?

(The President cuts off the speaker)

3-0257-0000.sourceText:
Herr talman! Kommissionär! FN larmar om att Israel medvetet attackerar och dödar palestinska barn. Detta är barn som sover, barn som leker, barn som flyr, barn som är måltavlor. Kan ni se era barn i ögonen och säga att ni har gjort allt i er makt för att stoppa folkmordet? Kan ni det?

Människor som demonstrerar på gator och torg har betydligt mer civilkurage än den ryggradslösa politiska elit som fortsätter att gång på gång skydda krigsbrottslingen Netanyahu. Världen ser denna medbrottslighet. Ni visste allt och ni gjorde ingenting.

Stoppa handelsavtalet med Israel och ställ mördarna inför rätta.
3-0257-0000.englishText:
Mr Speaker! Commissioner! The UN warns that Israel is deliberately attacking and killing Palestinian children. These are children who sleep, children who play, children who run away, children who are targets. Can you look your children in the eye and say that you have done everything in your power to stop the genocide? Can you do that?

People demonstrating in the streets and squares have far more civil courage than the spineless political elite who continue to protect the war criminal Netanyahu again and again. The world sees this complicity. You knew everything and you did nothing.

Stop the trade deal with Israel and bring the killers to justice.

3-0259-0000.sourceText:
Voorzitter, hoe kan deze Commissie zichzelf nog in de ogen kijken. Hoe doen onze regeringsleiders dat eigenlijk? Terwijl Gaza levend wordt begraven en de Westelijke Jordaanoever wordt opgeslokt, nederzetting per nederzetting. En dat in real time voor onze ogen. En laten we ook stoppen met te zeggen dat dit een ingewikkeld verhaal is. Dat is het niet. Het geweld is onwettig, de bezetting is onwettig, de nederzettingen zijn illegaal.

De Verenigde Naties zeggen ons dat, het Internationaal Gerechtshof heeft het gezegd en ook vanuit de Europese Unie moet dat luid en duidelijk blijven klinken. En toch gebeurt er niets. En dat heeft een naam: medeplichtigheid. Schors dat associatieverdrag volledig, verbiedt de handel in producten uit illegale nederzettingen en breidt die sancties uit. Deze Commissie wilde ooit een geopolitieke Commissie zijn. Europa wil een belangrijke rol spelen op het geopolitieke toneel. Wel, doe dan iets. Woorden volstaan niet. Free Palestine. Nu.
3-0259-0000.englishText:
Mr President, how can this Commission still look itself in the eye? How do our government leaders actually do that? While Gaza is being buried alive and the West Bank is being swallowed up, settlement by settlement. And that in real time before our eyes. And let's also stop saying that this is a complicated story. It's not. The violence is illegal, the occupation is illegal, the settlements are illegal.

The United Nations tells us this, the International Court of Justice has said it and the European Union must also continue to say it loud and clear. And yet nothing happens. And that has a name: complicity. Suspend that association agreement completely, ban the trade in products from illegal settlements and expand those sanctions. This Commission once wanted to be a geopolitical Commission. Europe wants to play an important role on the geopolitical stage. Well, then do something. Words are not enough. Free Palestine. Now.

3-0261-0000.sourceText:
Señor presidente, señora comisaria, le tengo que confesar algo. Tras Gaza, tras mil días de genocidio, yo soy otra persona. Nadie puede convivir con tanto horror sin cambiar su forma de estar en el mundo, de verse a sí mismo y a la humanidad.

Hoy debatimos sobre Israel, pero en realidad debatimos sobre nosotros. Sucedió y puede volver a suceder. Nos lo advirtió Primo Levi después de Auschwitz. ¿Y nosotros qué le dijimos? No, nunca más... lo prometimos. Mentimos. Está volviendo a suceder. Y ustedes se hacen fotos con los responsables.

¿Somos mejores que aquellos que miraron a otro lado cuando deportaban a judíos como Primo Levi? Somos peores, porque ahora no podemos decir que no sabíamos, ni tan siquiera que no participábamos. Cuando nos preguntamos por quién doblan las campanas, doblan por nosotros.

¿Qué será de nosotros después de Gaza, señora comisaria? Los lugares más oscuros del infierno nos esperan: a la derecha —que hoy no está aquí— por su participación en el genocidio, por deshumanizarse, y a nosotros por no impedirlo.
3-0261-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, Madam Commissioner, I have to confess something to you. After Gaza, after a thousand days of genocide, I am a different person. No one can live with so much horror without changing their way of being in the world, of seeing themselves and humanity.

Today we debate about Israel, but in reality we debate about ourselves. It happened and it can happen again. Primo Levi warned us after Auschwitz. And what did we tell him? No, never again... we promised. We lie. It's happening again. And you take photos with those responsible.

Are we better than those who looked the other way when Jews like Primo Levi were deported? We are worse, because now we cannot say that we did not know, or even that we did not participate. When we ask ourselves for whom the bell tolls, it tolls for us.

What will become of us after Gaza, Commissioner? The darkest places in hell await us: on the right—which is not here today—for its participation in the genocide, for dehumanizing itself, and for us for not preventing it.

3-0263-0000.sourceText:
Senhor Presidente, Senhora Comissária Šuica, enquanto discutimos a reconstrução de Gaza, a destruição no terreno continua.

O cessar-fogo é uma mentira. Israel continua a assassinar palestinianos, a impedir a entrada da ajuda humanitária de que necessitam, a atacar acampamentos de palestinianos desalojados, a destruir infraestruturas civis, algumas delas construídas com financiamento da União Europeia.

Enquanto aqui discutimos a responsabilização de Israel pelas violações do direito internacional, a União Europeia mantém a sua plena cumplicidade com o genocídio. A Senhora Comissária foi a Israel para reafirmar que as relações políticas, económicas e até de cooperação militar com Israel se mantêm a todo o vapor: a prova mais evidente da cumplicidade da União Europeia com o genocídio está aqui.

Nem o relatório da Comissão de Inquérito das Nações Unidas, que denuncia o genocídio e os crimes cometidos por Israel contra as crianças, faz a União Europeia corar de vergonha e reverter o caminho.

Mas esse tem de ser o sentido: garantir o respeito pelos direitos do povo palestiniano, pôr fim ao genocídio.
3-0263-0000.englishText:
Mr President, Commissioner Šuica, while we discuss the reconstruction of Gaza, the destruction on the ground continues.

The ceasefire is a lie. Israel continues to murder Palestinians, prevent the entry of the humanitarian aid they need, attack camps of displaced Palestinians, destroy civil infrastructure, some of it built with funding from the European Union.

While here we discuss Israel's accountability for violations of international law, the European Union maintains its full complicity in the genocide. The Commissioner went to Israel to reaffirm that political, economic and even military cooperation relations with Israel remain at full steam: the most obvious proof of the European Union's complicity in the genocide is here.

Not even the report of the United Nations Commission of Inquiry, which denounces the genocide and crimes committed by Israel against children, makes the European Union blush with shame and reverse course.

But that has to be the meaning: guaranteeing respect for the rights of the Palestinian people, putting an end to the genocide.

3-0264-0000.sourceText:
Sur President, kollegi, tlabt li nitkellem f'dan id-dibattitu f'isem iż-żgħażagħ li niltaqa' magħhom Malta. Iż-żgħażagħ jgħiduli "Xbajna bid-double standards, xbajna bl-ipokrezija Ewropea." Jiena irrid il-prosperità tal-poplu Palestinjan daqskemm irrid is-sigurtà tal-Iżraeliti f'darhom. Però l-akbar kontribut li rridu nagħmlu għat-tnejn li huma, huwa li ninsistu fuq il-legalità. Għalhekk ma nistgħux nibqgħu nappoġġjaw ftehim tal-kummerċ kif għandna bħalissa mal-Iżrael. Qisu xejn mhu xejn.

Il-President von der Leyen f'din l-istess plenarja hawnhekk, wegħditna sospensjoni ta' dan il-ftehim. X'ġara sadanittant? Weħilna f'deadlock bejn il-gvernijiet. Emmnuni ħbieb tiegħi, jiena nistħi nispjega din is-sitwazzjoni lit-tifel tiegħi ta' erbatax-il sena. Nistħi ngħid li l-Ewropa hija kompletament impotenti. Għandna kriżi ta' kredibbiltà li noħorġu minnha billi jkollna rikostruzzjoni accountable li la sservi lill-Ħamas u lanqas biex jerġgħu jitkissru l-binjiet... 

(Il-President irtira l-kelma lill-kelliem)
3-0264-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, colleagues, I asked to speak in this debate on behalf of the young people I meet in Malta. The young people tell me "We are fed up with double standards, we are fed up with European hypocrisy." I want the prosperity of the Palestinian people as much as I want the security of the Israelis at home. But the biggest contribution we want to make for both of them, is to insist on legality. Therefore we can no longer support a trade agreement as we currently have with Israel. It's like nothing is nothing.

President von der Leyen in this same plenary here, promised us a suspension of this agreement. What happened in the meantime? We are stuck in a deadlock between governments. Believe me my friends, I am ashamed to explain this situation to my fourteen year old son. I am ashamed to say that Europe is completely impotent. We have a crisis of credibility that we will get out of by having an accountable reconstruction that neither serves Hamas nor to destroy the buildings again... 

(The President withdrew the word to the speaker)

3-0267-0000.sourceText: Voorzitter, we praten over de wederopbouw van Gaza alsof er een natuurramp heeft plaatsgehad. Maar de realiteit is anders: als onderdeel van een genocidale campagne heeft Israël 85 % van Gaza met de grond gelijk gemaakt. Er is op papier een staakt‑het‑vuren, dus zou wederopbouw mogelijk moeten zijn en zou humanitaire hulp mogelijk moeten zijn. Maar dat verhult de werkelijkheid. Ook zijn sinds dat staakt‑het‑vuren meer dan duizend Palestijnen gedood en duizenden gewonden gevallen. En de hulp die wel binnenkomt is onvoldoende en aan banden gelegd met absurde beperkingen. Protheses worden tegengehouden als militaire middelen. Deze week nog werden hulpverleners blootgesteld aan luchtaanvallen. Onder zulke omstandigheden is het onmogelijk om te spreken over wederopbouw en een fatsoenlijk gesprek daarover te hebben. Het beleid van de Israëlische regering is niet veranderd. Zolang Europa dit blindelings laat gebeuren, is trots praten over de Europese inzet voor wederopbouw en humanitaire hulp niets meer dan een schaamlap. Het Palestijnse volk verdient wederopbouw en humanitaire hulp. Daarom moet het Associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Israël worden opgeschort.
3-0267-0000.englishText: Mr President, we are talking about the reconstruction of Gaza as if a natural disaster had occurred. But the reality is different: as part of a genocidal campaign, Israel razed 85% of Gaza to the ground. There is a ceasefire on paper, so reconstruction should be possible and humanitarian aid should be possible. But that obscures the reality. Since the ceasefire, more than a thousand Palestinians have been killed and thousands injured. And the aid that does come in is insufficient and subject to absurd restrictions. Prosthetics are held back as military tools. Just this week, aid workers were exposed to air strikes. Under such circumstances it is impossible to talk about reconstruction and have a decent conversation about it. The Israeli government's policy has not changed. As long as Europe blindly allows this to happen, talking proudly about the European commitment to reconstruction and humanitarian aid is nothing more than a shame. The Palestinian people deserve reconstruction and humanitarian aid. That is why the Association Agreement between the EU and Israel must be suspended.

3-0268-0000.sourceText:
Signor Presidente, signora Commissaria, onorevoli colleghi, sono stato con altri parlamentari nella Cisgiordania, nei territori occupati.

Abbiamo visto, appena arrivati nella città di Hebron, una curva dove ci è stato indicato che c'erano ancora delle macchie di sangue di alcuni palestinesi uccisi qualche giorno prima e abbiamo chiesto: "Ma perché non vi rivolgete alla giustizia?" "No, perché noi non abbiamo la giustizia normale. Noi abbiamo la giustizia militare, e la prima cosa che farebbero sarebbe venire a distruggere la nostra casa."

Ho visto un bambino che non aveva l'incubatrice: nato sottopeso, era in una scatola di scarpe con del cotone; una sposa che piangeva perché, dietro di lei, la sua casa era distrutta per motivi di sicurezza.

Non possiamo continuare in questo modo. Ho visto trattare esattamente quel popolo come sono stati trattati gli ebrei durante la Seconda guerra mondiale.

Dobbiamo sanzionare Israele, interrompere ogni contatto con Israele, perché Israele ascolta, in questo momento, con il suo governo, solo la forza.
3-0268-0000.englishText:
Mr President, Commissioner, ladies and gentlemen, I have been with other parliamentarians in the West Bank, in the occupied territories.

As soon as we arrived in the city of Hebron, we saw a curve where it was pointed out to us that there were still bloodstains from some Palestinians killed a few days earlier and we asked: "But why don't you turn to justice?" "No, because we don't have normal justice. We have military justice, and the first thing they would do is come and destroy our house."

I saw a baby who didn't have an incubator: born underweight, he was in a shoe box with cotton; a bride crying because, behind her, her house was destroyed for safety reasons.

We can't continue like this. I saw those people treated exactly as the Jews were treated during the Second World War.

We must sanction Israel, interrupt all contact with Israel, because Israel listens, at this moment, with its government, only to force.

3-0269-0000.sourceText:
Senhor Presidente, o Tribunal Internacional de Justiça foi claro: Israel tem obrigações. Tem de garantir o essencial à sobrevivência da população de Gaza. Tem de deixar entrar ajudas, sem exceções. Mais, o Tribunal rejeitou com factos as desculpas usadas para bloquear essas mesmas ajudas.

Uma decisão do Tribunal que não é cumprida não é só uma decisão ignorada. É o direito internacional posto em causa e quem viola o direito internacional tem de responder por isso perante a justiça e perante a História.

Não pode haver impunidade. Não pode haver regras para uns, exceções para outros. A História julgará não só aqueles que violaram direitos humanos, como aqueles que assistiram e nada disseram.

Basta de palavras sem consequências! É tempo de suspender o Acordo de Associação União Europeia-Israel!
3-0269-0000.englishText:
Mr President, the International Court of Justice has been clear: Israel has obligations. It must guarantee what is essential for the survival of the population of Gaza. You have to let help in, no exceptions. Furthermore, the Court rejected with facts the excuses used to block these same aids.

A Court decision that is not complied with is not just a decision ignored. International law is being called into question and anyone who violates international law must answer for it before the courts and before History.

There can be no impunity. There cannot be rules for some, exceptions for others. History will judge not only those who violated human rights, but also those who watched and said nothing.

Enough words without consequences! It is time to suspend the European Union-Israel Association Agreement!

3-0270-0000.sourceText:
(inicio de la intervención fuera de micrófono)...no puede mirar hacia otro lado mientras denuncia lo que pasa en Gaza. Mientras pedimos que se aplique el Derecho internacional en Ucrania, pero no lo aplicamos con la misma firmeza en Palestina, el mundo entiende una cosa terrible: que en Europa no todas las vidas valen lo mismo.

Este doble estándar está destruyendo nuestra credibilidad y nuestra dignidad. Gaza ha pasado de ser una cárcel al aire libre —como decía Borrell— a un cementerio al aire libre. Y cuando dentro de unos años mi hijo me pregunte qué hizo Europa para frenar el genocidio en Gaza yo quiero decirle que no miramos hacia otro lado. Por eso, Europa debe actuar ya, debe pedir el alto el fuego inmediato, el fin de la ocupación, pero hoy les pedimos a los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores una medida urgente: que se suspenda el Acuerdo de Asociación UE‑Israel.

Porque cuando Europa calla ante Gaza no solo pierde su credibilidad, sino también su alma.
3-0270-0000.englishText:
(beginning of intervention off microphone)...he cannot look away while he denounces what is happening in Gaza. While we call for international law to be applied in Ukraine, but do not apply it with the same firmness in Palestine, the world understands a terrible thing: that in Europe not all lives are worth the same.

This double standard is destroying our credibility and our dignity. Gaza has gone from being an open-air prison—as Borrell said—to an open-air cemetery. And when in a few years my son asks me what Europe did to stop the genocide in Gaza, I want to tell him that we are not looking the other way. For this reason, Europe must act now, it must call for an immediate ceasefire, an end to the occupation, but today we ask the foreign ministers for an urgent measure: to suspend the EU-Israel Association Agreement.

Because when Europe remains silent in the face of Gaza, it not only loses its credibility, but also its soul.

3-0274-0000.sourceText:
Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, a Gaza il genocidio non è mai finito.

Le parole del patriarca di Gerusalemme, Pizzaballa, sono come pietre: mancano acqua, cibo, medicinali, i topi mordono i bambini, mentre le persone muoiono.

Hamas sembra aprire al trasferimento dell'amministrazione civile, ma non al disarmo. E intanto si parla del dispiegamento di un contingente marocchino.

Il piano di Trump avanza nel vuoto lasciato dall'Europa, ma la ricostruzione di Gaza deve essere sotto l'egida delle Nazioni Unite e delle sue agenzie, come l'UNRWA.

Per questo serve dare messaggi netti ora, di fronte alla deriva del governo israeliano. Mi rivolgo al governo italiano in primis, a Giorgia Meloni: abbia il coraggio, per una volta, e tolga il veto sulla sospensione dell'accordo di associazione UE‑Israele, riconosca, come Italia, lo Stato di Palestina. È necessario che almeno la parte commerciale degli accordi sia sospesa, come abbiamo chiesto in questo Parlamento.

L'Europa rompa con il doppio standard e faccia ciò che serve per restituire dignità e libertà ai palestinesi.

Stop al genocidio, stop al terrorismo, stop alla violenza. Lavoriamo insieme per ricostruzione e pace.
3-0274-0000.englishText:
Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, the genocide has never ended in Gaza.

The words of the patriarch of Jerusalem, Pizzaballa, are like stones: there is a lack of water, food, medicines, mice bite children, while people die.

Hamas seems open to the transfer of the civil administration, but not to disarmament. And in the meantime there is talk of the deployment of a Moroccan contingent.

Trump's plan advances in the vacuum left by Europe, but the reconstruction of Gaza must be under the aegis of the United Nations and its agencies, such as UNRWA.

This is why it is necessary to give clear messages now, in the face of the drift of the Israeli government. I turn to the Italian government first and foremost, to Giorgia Meloni: have the courage, for once, and remove the veto on the suspension of the EU-Israel association agreement, recognize, as Italy, the State of Palestine. It is necessary that at least the commercial part of the agreements be suspended, as we have asked for in this Parliament.

Europe should break with the double standard and do what it takes to restore dignity and freedom to the Palestinians.

Stop genocide, stop terrorism, stop violence. Let us work together for reconstruction and peace.

3-0282-0000.sourceText:
Nākamais darba kārtības punkts ir debates par Komisijas paziņojumu par narkotiku tirdzniecību Eiropas ūdeņos – mūsu robežu aizsardzība un tiesībaizsardzības amatpersonu atbalstīšana (2026/2797(RSP)).

Vēlos atgādināt runātājiem, ka, ņemot vērā pašlaik spēkā esošos testa režīma pasākumus un noteikto debašu beigu laiku, būs stingri jāievēro uzstāšanās laiks, tai skaitā visiem runātājiem, ne tikai deputātiem.
3-0282-0000.englishText:
The next item on the agenda is the debate on the Commission communication on drug trafficking in European waters - protecting our borders and supporting law enforcement officers (2026/2797(RSP)).

I would like to remind the speakers that, taking into account the currently valid test regime measures and the set end time of the debate, the speaking time will have to be strictly adhered to, including all speakers, not only MPs.

3-0284-0000.sourceText:
Senhor Presidente, o narcotráfico marítimo no Atlântico está a evoluir rapidamente e pressiona cada vez mais as fronteiras da União Europeia. Falamos de redes mais organizadas, mais agressivas, mais sofisticadas, com impacto direto na nossa segurança interna e na nossa capacidade de resposta.

As operações recentes em Espanha e em Portugal, nas quais lamentamos a morte de agentes da Guardia Civil e da GNR, mostram que esta é uma ameaça estruturada e cada vez mais impune. Só em 2025 deixámos escapar cerca de 192 embarcações e 700 toneladas de cocaína no Atlântico. As redes adaptam-se: mudam de rota, usam a África Ocidental como ponto de transbordo, recorrem a embarcações de alta velocidade e a narcossubmarinos para redistribuir a droga por diferentes rotas. No mar, continuam a ter vantagem pela mobilidade, pelo alcance e pela rapidez de fuga.

A Comissão Europeia não pode limitar-se a acompanhar o fenómeno. Tem de liderar uma resposta operacional, legislativa e tecnológica à altura da ameaça.

Precisamos de mais financiamento, sim, mas precisamos sobretudo de mais capacidade, mais vigilância aérea, mais partilha de informação e de inteligência, mais instrumentos operacionais.

Precisamos também de rever com seriedade as regras de intervenção no mar, com uma abordagem clara sobre o uso proporcional da força em operações marítimas de alto risco. A Comissão deve ainda avançar com legislação europeia sobre a posse, a modificação e a operação de embarcações de alta potência utilizadas pelo crime organizado. Deve apoiar tecnologias capazes de neutralizar motores à distância e deve reforçar a cooperação com os Estados-Membros e com os países da África Ocidental, onde muitas destas rotas se consolidam.

Senhor Comissário, não podemos pedir às nossas forças de segurança que enfrentem organizações que não conhecem fronteiras com meios limitados, com regras desajustadas, com financiamento pensado para os desafios do século passado. Não podemos exigir eficácia sem lhes dar capacidade.

Esta é uma questão de segurança, de soberania e de Estado de direito.
3-0284-0000.englishText:
Mr President, maritime drug trafficking in the Atlantic is evolving rapidly and is placing increasing pressure on the European Union's borders. We are talking about more organized, more aggressive, more sophisticated networks, with a direct impact on our internal security and our ability to respond.

Recent operations in Spain and Portugal, in which we mourn the deaths of Guardia Civil and GNR agents, show that this is a structured threat that is increasingly unpunished. In 2025 alone, around 192 vessels and 700 tons of cocaine escaped into the Atlantic. The networks adapt: ​​they change routes, use West Africa as a transshipment point, use high-speed vessels and narco-submarines to redistribute the drugs along different routes. At sea, they continue to have an advantage due to mobility, range and speed of escape.

The European Commission cannot limit itself to monitoring the phenomenon. It must lead an operational, legislative and technological response to the threat.

We need more funding, yes, but above all we need more capacity, more aerial surveillance, more information and intelligence sharing, more operational instruments.

We also need to seriously review the rules of intervention at sea, with a clear approach to the proportional use of force in high-risk maritime operations. The Commission must also come forward with European legislation on the possession, modification and operation of high-powered vessels used by organized crime. It must support technologies capable of neutralizing engines from a distance and must reinforce cooperation with Member States and West African countries, where many of these routes are consolidated.

Commissioner, we cannot ask our security forces to face organizations that do not know borders with limited resources, with inadequate rules, with funding designed for the challenges of the last century. We cannot demand effectiveness without giving them capacity.

This is a question of security, sovereignty and the rule of law.

3-0285-0000.sourceText:
Señor presidente, señor comisario, llevamos dos años de legislatura del Parlamento Europeo y es raro el pleno —si es que hay alguno— que se libre de un punto en el que las fuerzas que hacen oposición al Gobierno de España no lo aprovechen instrumentalmente para criticarlo.

Resulta deplorable en un asunto tan sensible que debería concitar tanto nuestra unidad como es la lucha contra el narcotráfico en nuestras fronteras exteriores y el apoyo a las fuerzas y cuerpos de seguridad, que es exactamente lo que hace el Gobierno de España.

El ministro del Interior ha incrementado en 17 000 los policías y los guardias civiles —4 000 de ellos en Andalucía— durante el mandato del Gobierno progresista que preside Pedro Sánchez. Se han invertido 2 000 millones EUR en infraestructuras de comisarías y, por tanto, centros de seguridad en la zona del Campo de Gibraltar.

Evidentemente, este asunto tiene dimensión europea y, por tanto, lo que importa es la Estrategia de la UE sobre Drogas y el plan de acción de la UE contra el narcotráfico, con coordinación europea y en colaboración con Eurojust y con Europol.

Tal y como sugiere la Agencia de la Unión Europea sobre Drogas —situada en Lisboa—, tiene que haber una partida europea para recursos europeos y, por supuesto, la protección de víctimas. Debemos ponernos del lado de las víctimas sin hacernos jamás la foto con los narcotraficantes.
3-0285-0000.englishText:
Mr. President, Mr. Commissioner, we have been in the European Parliament for two years and it is rare for a plenary session—if there is one—to get rid of a point in which the forces that oppose the Government of Spain do not take advantage of it instrumentally to criticize it.

It is deplorable in such a sensitive matter that should bring together our unity, such as the fight against drug trafficking on our external borders and support for security forces and bodies, which is exactly what the Government of Spain does.

The Minister of the Interior has increased the number of police and civil guards by 17,000 – 4,000 of them in Andalusia – during the mandate of the progressive Government chaired by Pedro Sánchez. EUR 2 billion have been invested in police station infrastructure and therefore security centers in the Campo de Gibraltar area.

Obviously, this issue has a European dimension and, therefore, what matters is the EU Drugs Strategy and the EU action plan against drug trafficking, with European coordination and in collaboration with Eurojust and Europol.

As the European Union Drugs Agency – located in Lisbon – suggests, there must be a European allocation for European resources and, of course, the protection of victims. We must stand on the side of the victims without ever taking photos with drug traffickers.

3-0286-0000.sourceText:
Señor presidente, el narcotráfico no es solo un enemigo terrible para la salud de los individuos y sociedades, hoy el narcotráfico es, además, un arma de guerra híbrida y un poder político colosal.

El crimen organizado ha entrado en la política. Hace décadas, los carteles de la droga se aliaron con la izquierda iberoamericana. Hoy, ese narcosocialismo del Foro de São Paulo ya está en Europa y entró por España.
